row.notes: robin_hood-style map rehash(map, new bucket count p2, bool freeOld): new slot array (8-byte node ptrs) + info bytes allocated in one block (count*9+8, allocator [map+0x18] vt+0x10), max load 80 % (x0x50/100), overflow area min(0xff, 80 %); re-inserts every old node by hash (u32 key * [map+0x20], >>33 xor) with info-byte shifting and halving info (+0x50/+0x54) on overflow; old block freed (vt+0x38) or, when freeOld == 0 and large enough, chained into the node free list (+0x10/+8). The 0xff limit is the overflow, not the bucket count. (lane owner review requested)
